name: second-shift
description: Sets up a repo for second-shift, Claude Code plugins that ask the open design questions before building, turn a ticket into a pull request, and have a separate session review it. /second-shift:onboard detects your tracker and commands, writes the repo config, and pins the second-shift plugins to a release in the repo settings. /second-shift:doctor checks the install against that pin and prints the fix for each problem. /second-shift:local-dev-refresh updates the second-shift plugins on this machine.
